supported_checks.label_excerpt: Bilateral lower extremities angiograms via a transfemoral approach, balloon angioplasty of the left and right superficial femoral artery and left proximal popliteal artery
supported_checks.source_quote: Decision was made to perform bilateral lower extremities angiograms via a transfemoral approach with possible revascularization of the right lower extremity (LE) first and then the left side on two different procedures one week apart. Both procedures were accessed through a transfemoral approach that involved balloon angioplasty of the left (L) and right (R) superficial femoral artery (SFA) and left proximal popliteal artery.
supported_checks.explanation: The note supports the listed procedures and angioplasty sites.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: The following day after the right transfemoral access approach
supported_checks.source_quote: On the following day after the right transfemoral access approach, patient presents to ED with R groin and scrotal pain.
supported_checks.explanation: The timing and symptom presentation are supported.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: Pseudo-aneurysm on the R groin originating from the common femoral artery measuring 2.5 × 1.4 cm and extending into the R inguinal canal, filled with hemorrhage and extension into the R scrotum that measures 13.7 × 6.4 × 6.6 cm
supported_checks.source_quote: CT of the pelvis revealed a pseudo-aneurysm on the R groin originating from the common femoral artery (CFA) measuring 2.5 × 1.4 cm and extending into the R inguinal canal, filled with hemorrhage and extension into the R scrotum that measures 13.7 × 6.4 × 6.6 cm (Fig. ).
supported_checks.explanation: The recorded CT result matches the source description.

findings.source_quote: severe peripheral vascular disease with extensive smoking history
findings.explanation: Material smoking history is omitted from the relevant history leaf, though it is explicitly stated in the source.

findings.label_excerpt: Stenosis of superficial femoral artery of both lower extremities
findings.source_quote: CT angiography of the lower extremities showed critical stenosis of superficial femoral artery of both lower extremities
findings.explanation: The label omits the material severity qualifier “critical” from the angiographic finding.

findings.source_quote: Patient was discharged same day and aspirin and Plavix were resumed.
findings.explanation: The source says the medications were resumed, but does not specify that resumption occurred after discharge; that timing is added by the label.

findings.label_excerpt: Patient was discharged the same day with resumed aspirin and Plavix
findings.source_quote: Patient was discharged same day and aspirin and Plavix were resumed.
findings.explanation: The note establishes same-day discharge and medication resumption but does not state they were resumed with or after discharge; the label links the two events more tightly than the source does.

initial.summary: Most checked details are supported. Findings concern omitted smoking history and angiographic severity, plus unsupported timing/linkage of medication resumption to discharge.
